widgets_values: The image is a wide hand-drawn charcoal sketch portrait of a young East Asian woman rendered in a rough ink-and-charcoal illustration style, set against a textured off-white paper background with subtle grain and faint tonal variation across its surface. The background is a flat, unbleached cream paper with visible fibre texture, slightly darker at the edges suggesting a scanned or photographed sheet. In the upper-left quadrant, a large handwritten brush-script headline reads "Still Here" in thick black strokes, the letters loose and expressive with uneven weight, the word "Still" stacked above "Here" and a short horizontal dash beneath. Directly below that headline, two lines of small black serif type read "Same me." and "A quieter day." in a lighter, more restrained weight than the brush-script above. The central subject occupies the middle and lower half of the frame: a young woman depicted from the shoulders up, her face turned slightly toward the viewer with a calm, neutral expression. Her hair is rendered in dense, heavy charcoal strokes, long and dark, falling past her shoulders on both sides and parted near the centre of her head, with the texture of individual strokes visible throughout. Her face is left mostly unshaded, the paper white showing through for skin, while her eyes are drawn as small dark ovals with defined brows above them, and her lips are a small dark mark. On the upper-left of her head, a small butterfly-shaped hair clip is suggested with a few delicate lines, echoing the accessory in the source photograph. She wears a scoop-neck top rendered in rough cross-hatched charcoal, the leopard-print pattern suggested through irregular dark spots and patches rather than detailed rendering, the neckline curving low across her chest. A thin gold necklace with a small round pendant hangs at her collarbone, drawn as a fine single line with a tiny circle at its centre. On the right side of the frame, roughly at mid-height, a small black serif label reads "NO. 01" with a thin horizontal rule drawn directly beneath it. Below that, in the lower-right area, three short lines of small black serif type read "Some faces" "carry" "silent stories." stacked vertically with generous leading. The lighting is flat and even across the entire composition, with no cast shadows or highlights, consistent with a hand-drawn illustration on a paper surface where all depth comes from line weight and stroke density rather than light direction. The overall composition is balanced and minimalist, with the dense dark charcoal mass of the figure anchoring the centre while the sparse text elements float in the negative space on either side, creating a quiet, contemplative mood on a restrained palette of black ink on cream paper.

少女留着暖棕调蓬松侧扎低马尾，轻薄空气刘海修饰脸型，侧边编发别着浅绿与鹅黄两颗圆款糖果发夹，圆眼通透灵动，脸颊晕开大面积粉嫩腮红，唇色淡粉柔和，右手轻贴脸颊托住下颌，身着浅白拼浅蓝领边短袖 T 恤，衣身印有卡通印花图案。背景是户外淡青蓝色哑光砖墙，墙面带有模糊白色字母印记，身旁挨着纹理粗糙的深褐色树干，整体是清新街边户外环境。阴天柔和漫射自然光均匀铺洒画面，无强烈硬阴影，面部光影过渡顺滑平缓，曝光亮度适中偏高，画面通透干净不会过曝丢失细节。整体色调以暖棕发丝、柔粉面妆、奶白衣衫搭配薄荷青墙面，整体是低饱和马卡龙浅色系，氛围清甜软萌，锚点叙事记录街边靠墙随手自拍的松弛少女日常瞬间。采用手机前置等效 35mm 镜头，f2.2 光圈适度虚化背景墙体与树干，正面近距离竖版半身特写构图，人物居于画面视觉中心，后期弱化锐利边缘增加朦胧雾面柔光质感，保留发丝毛流感、布料印花肌理与皮肤细腻质感，轻微降低对比度，整体是韩系甜妹网感头像写真风格，配色清爽治愈，构图紧凑柔和，充满元气软糯的日系少女纪实人像美学。

A close-up, landscape-oriented lifestyle portrait shows one young adult woman who appears East Asian, positioned slightly right of center and leaning against a rugged dark-brown tree trunk along the left side of the frame. Her face occupies much of the central area, captured from a slightly above eye-level angle in natural daylight. She has fair skin with a dewy sheen, soft peach-toned foundation, visible subtle freckles or small moles, warm reddish-pink blush across the cheeks, defined lashes, delicate eyeliner, lightly tinted brows, and glossy coral-pink lipstick. Her expression is calm and introspective, with large brown-gray eyes looking off-frame to the viewer’s right and her lips gently parted. Her right hand supports her cheek, with the palm pressing softly into her face and long fingers extending downward along the side of her nose and mouth, creating a quiet, contemplative pose.

Her hairstyle is a voluminous messy low side ponytail tied back loosely, exposing part of her ear and showing wispy stray hairs catching the backlight. Fine bangs fall irregularly over her forehead and partially cross her eyebrow and eye area. Several accessories decorate the hair, including a small glossy round clip featuring two colors of green and yellow candies pinned at the side. Small hoop earrings and layered chain-like pieces hang near her ear and neck. She wears a loose short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt with blue trim around the collar and sleeves; the fabric looks lightweight, washed, and slightly crumpled, suggesting cotton jersey. A faded printed illustration covers parts of the shirt: partial black outlined character forms appear around the chest, accompanied by a stylized animal or mascot figure with beige, tan, and olive-green areas near the lower-right portion of the garment. Her sleeve and forearm extend diagonally across the bottom-left foreground, reinforcing the informal self-shot composition.

The immediate environment consists of a weathered wooden backdrop painted pale cyan-blue. On the far left, the tree trunk runs vertically with deep bark ridges, cracked lines, circular knots, and shadowed crevices. Behind and around the subject, horizontal plank boards span most of the background, separated by thin dark seams. Their surface has pronounced wood grain, faint diagonal streaks, worn scratches, uneven tonal patches, darker smudges, chipped-looking texture, and some faded chalky white graffiti-like markings near the upper-right and mid-background areas where several characters form indistinct words or symbols. The background remains softly focused compared with the sharper face, producing a cinematic shallow-depth-of-field effect.

Lighting appears natural and directional from the upper left/backside, illuminating individual flyaway hairs and giving them golden rim-light highlights. Soft sunlight falls across the subject’s face and arm, while cooler shadows remain in the bark groove and planks, resulting in mixed warmth and cool color grading. The overall aesthetic feels realistic, candid, fashion-editorial, and atmospheric, emphasizing skin texture, windblown hair, distressed wood, and the contrast between the model’s soft features, the rough organic tree, and the matte urban-plank setting.
